title: Waiver of a contractual requirement
summary: Waiver concerns a party’s decision or conduct giving up the right to insist on a contractual requirement, including a condition placed for that party’s protection.
notes:
A party may act in a way that communicates it will accept performance despite an unmet requirement. The question is what right was relinquished, what the conduct reasonably meant, and whether the other party relied or the governing rule otherwise makes that relinquishment effective. Waiver is distinct from an agreed modification supported by the requirements applicable to changing the bargain.

The assigned mitigating-doctrines materials use waiver alongside estoppel and prevention. Those doctrines can overlap in consequences, but their reasons differ. Preserve the specific facts showing why the party could or could not later insist on strict compliance.
